# Climate-ADAPT

> Europe's comprehensive knowledge platform for climate adaptation, providing policy guidance, risk assessments, and sector-specific resilience strategies.

Climate-ADAPT is the European Environment Agency's central hub for climate adaptation information, supporting EU policy implementation and regional adaptation planning. It combines AI-powered search capabilities with expert resources covering all major economic sectors and cross-cutting climate resilience challenges.

## Key Topics

- Climate adaptation
- European Climate Risk Assessment
- EU adaptation policy
- Climate resilience
- Sector adaptation
- Climate-health impacts
- Vulnerability assessment
- EU Mission on Adaptation
- European Climate and Health Observatory
- Risk management
- Coastal adaptation
- Agricultural resilience
- Energy transition
- Biodiversity conservation
- Disaster risk reduction

## Core Platform Services

- [Climate-ADAPT Homepage](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en): Main entry point showcasing key services, thematic features and adaptation tools for European climate resilience
- [AI Search Assistant](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/ai-search-assistant): AI-powered search tool for discovering climate adaptation knowledge, data, and policy resources across the platform
- [Climate Adaptation Networks](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/resolveuid/811135e5337c415c91fd2f1f268d1e26): Global networks connecting organizations and facilitating international cooperation on climate adaptation strategies

## EU Policy & Strategic Initiatives

- [European Climate Risk Assessment](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/eu-adaptation-policy/key-eu-actions/european-climate-risk-assessment): Comprehensive assessment of climate risks across Europe, providing evidence-based analysis for adaptation planning
- [EU Mission on Adaptation to Climate Change](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/mission): Portal for EU Mission initiatives with regional adaptation support tools and implementation guidance

## Sector-Specific Adaptation

- [Agriculture](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/eu-adaptation-policy/sector-policies/agriculture): Agriculture sector adaptation guidance covering climate risks, resilience strategies, and sustainable farming practices
- [Energy](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/eu-adaptation-policy/sector-policies/energy): Energy sector adaptation covering renewable energy transition and infrastructure resilience to climate impacts
- [Buildings](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/eu-adaptation-policy/sector-policies/buildings): Buildings sector adaptation addressing energy efficiency, cooling needs, and climate-resilient construction
- [Coastal Areas](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/eu-adaptation-policy/sector-policies/coastal-areas): Coastal adaptation strategies addressing sea-level rise, erosion, and marine ecosystem resilience
- [Forestry](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/eu-adaptation-policy/sector-policies/forestry): Forestry adaptation strategy enhancing forest resilience, biodiversity, and ecosystem service provision
- [Biodiversity](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/eu-adaptation-policy/sector-policies/biodiversity): Biodiversity adaptation framework with ecosystem-based approaches and species conservation strategies
- [Financial Services](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/eu-adaptation-policy/sector-policies/financial): Financial sector adaptation addressing climate risk disclosure, sustainable investment, and economic resilience

## Cross-Cutting Adaptation Topics

- [Disaster Risk Reduction](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/eu-adaptation-policy/sector-policies/disaster-risk-reduction): Disaster risk reduction framework addressing extreme weather hazards and climate-related emergency preparedness
- [Cultural Heritage](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/eu-adaptation-policy/sector-policies/cultural-heritage): Cultural heritage adaptation strategy protecting historical sites and cultural assets from climate impacts

## Specialized Observatories & Portals

- [European Climate and Health Observatory](https://climate-adapt.eea.europa.eu/en/observatory): Dedicated observatory supporting climate adaptation and health resilience through evidence and monitoring
